visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short dark hair, wearing a pink sleeveless dress with a large bow on the chest, sits on a green fabric sofa. She holds a large unfolded smartphone, examining its wide screen. The living room background features a dark metal shelf with books and a simple framed picture on the wall. (2) The scene transitions to the girl lying on her back on the sofa, holding the large device above her face with both hands. She smiles at the camera while demonstrating the ease of using the device in a reclined position. Bright yellow captions appear at the bottom. (3) A screen recording of the mobile game Genshin Impact is shown, highlighting how the expansive screen displays the game's environment, interface, and character (a blonde female protagonist) near a body of water. The visual layout is clean and wide. (4) The girl is shown in a close-up pointing at the thin edge of the smartphone placed on a wooden table to emphasize its slim profile. (5) Finally, she stands in front of a neutral grey wall, now wearing a professional black blazer over her pink dress. She folds the large device in half, transforming it into a standard phone size, and smoothly slides it into her blazer pocket while smiling at the camera.
